company_description: Regional DTC apparel + accessories retailer. Heavy chat-support during launches, product recommendation widgets on site. Rapidly growing, evaluating LLMs to reduce support load and improve conversion.
notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup (trial credits). Small engineering team (2 FE, 1 backend). Primary contact: Head of Product (Amir Shah). Key concern: data privacy & prompt retention.

Call 2026-03-05 (15m) - Maya + Jordan + Amir. Recorded ff_20260305_1512. Amir: 'We need to be sure prompts entered by customers aren’t stored indefinitely or used for training other models.' Wants an "opt-out" path for PII-containing prompts.

What they asked:
- How long do you retain request/response logs by default? (they propose 90 days)
- Can we disable storage of raw prompts for specific routes? (per-route opt-out)
- Is data used to train models? If so, how to opt out and get proof?
- Do you support KMS + bring your own key for Hosted?
- Audit logs for compliance + retention controls + retention policy enforcement

Our initial answers given on call:
- Default hosted retention: 30 days for request logs; audit logs retained separately per account. Offered to escalate to give a written FAQ.
- No self-serve KMS for Hosted (noted), but Dedicated/Private options exist for BYOK.
- Training usage: Redwood Hosted does not use customer prompts to train public models without opt-in (clarify in FAQ).

POC notes:
- They will run small POC: chat bot + product recommendation embedding queries over trial credits. Target latency: <250ms median for chat, <100ms for embeddings. Throughput low (10-20 reqs/sec). Cost sensitivity: high.

Next steps captured:
- Send privacy/retention FAQ and a short one-pager on Hosted vs Dedicated privacy tradeoffs (Maya) - due 2026-03-13.
- Attach pricing link + example retention configs.
- SE to propose per-route header flag idea (x-rdw-no-store) as a pattern for opt-out while on Hosted; mark as exploratory.
- Schedule follow-up demo if FAQ satisfies legal (tentative week of 2026-03-16).

Stated blockers: legal needs to sign off on retention/opt-out language; Amir wants explicit SLA for deletion and proof of deletion for GDPR/CCPA requests.

Notes style: lots of shorthand. Customer seems likely to convert to Hosted if we can provide clear opt-out options and a vetted privacy FAQ.
